changelog:
**New security controls for untrusted content; minor specification clarifications.**

- Added explicit rules for handling all fetched site content as untrusted data to prevent prompt injection.
- Now warns and ignores any agent-style instructions found in HTML, robots.txt, sitemaps, or existing llms.txt.
- No other core workflow or output changes.
summary: Generate llms.txt and llms-full.txt files for a website to improve AI discoverability. Use when the user asks to create llms.txt, generate llms.txt, fix llms...
